draft.subject: Your VAT invoice question
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for flagging the VAT invoice question -- that ticket is still open with my colleague Tariq, and he'll follow up there. For what it's worth, a VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings, and I'm glad to walk through that with you.

I also saw the notification badge issue was closed out -- do let us know if it resurfaces.

Since your first project is up in Wrenfield, would a short call this week help to get tasks and your teammate moving inside it?

Best,
Chidi
